name: Candy Land
description: Ten candy-themed maps normalized to the shared project map catalog layout.

maps.name: Lollipop Lawn
maps.theme: Open frosting meadow with lollipop trees, gumdrop bushes, cupcake huts, jellybean patches and icing ponds.

maps.name: Gumdrop Grove
maps.theme: Candy orchard with giant gumdrop clusters, lollipop trees, jellybean trails, caramel puddles and cupcake sheds.

maps.name: Peppermint Plaza
maps.theme: Structured candy-town plaza with waffle streets, peppermint roundabouts, striped awnings, fountains and candy-cane dividers.

maps.name: Cookie Carnival
maps.theme: Festive cookie-and-donut carnival with circular plazas, cookie booths, frosting tents, candy lights and donut rides.

maps.name: Chocolate Canal
maps.theme: Candy district split by glossy chocolate canals, wafer bridges, marshmallow docks, cookie barges and fudge embankments.

maps.name: Marshmallow Marina
maps.theme: Marshmallow lagoons with fluffy islands, candy boardwalks, jelly docks, syrup pools and puffy bridges.

maps.name: Jellybean Junction
maps.theme: Busy candy crossroads with jellybean boulevards, candy-cane medians, peppermint traffic circles, gummy parking lots and shop blocks.

maps.name: Taffy Factory
maps.theme: Whimsical candy factory with taffy conveyors, licorice pipes, gum machines, fondant mixers, syrup vats and wrapped-candy crates.

maps.name: Licorice Labyrinth
maps.theme: Dense maze of twisting licorice walls, peppermint gates, cookie courtyards, candy vaults and shortcut loops.

maps.name: Sugar Storm Citadel
maps.theme: Grand candy fortress with central sugar castle, layered courtyards, chocolate moat sections, wafer bridges, peppermint towers and royal candy gardens.
